2013 press release: MDRhythm partnered with NAFC (1,200+ free/charitable clinics) to provide affordable EMR/PM. Describes TechSoft as 25+ years in business, MDRhythm as hybrid EHR (EMR component ~14 years old at time of release), designed by practicing healthcare providers, in use since 1992.

IdenTrust EPCS partnership page. MDRhythm supports electronic prescriptions for controlled substances via IdenTrust identity proofing and two-factor authentication. Supports USB token, mobile auth, or identity proofing only configurations.
MDR Online patient portal login page. Confirms portal is operational. Portal hosted separately from main vendor site.

Patient portal terms and conditions. Portal operated by Techsoft in partnership with healthcare providers. Patients can maintain health profile, request appointments, request Rx refills, access medical information. Activities tracked through computer audit. User entries may become part of medical record.
1-800 Notify integration for automated appointment reminders. MDRhythm exports schedule as PDF for call/text reminder processing.
HG Insights listing for MDRhythm. Product is listed but all detailed data (customer count, market share, competitors) is behind paywall.

Alternate domain for TechSoft Inc. Page title is 'Welcome to Techsoft Inc. Medical Systems'. Confirms medstech.com is another TechSoft domain, explaining the contact email parag.dadhania@medstech.com.
